messages:
Maya (CS): Quick alert — NovaRetail renewal in 12 days. Usage plateaued; onboarding checklist stuck at ~60%. NPS 6 last week.
Ethan (CSM): They reported slow CSV imports and a couple of templates returning inconsistent results. One PM said 'weird tokenization' on exports.
Sophie (Enablement): Can we do a micro-workshop? 20m live + 10m follow-up. Short checklist audit has moved conversion for similar customers.
Rohit (RevOps): We should prepare a downgrade-safe commercial path instead of a blunt discount. Maybe 3mo reduced rate + feature-preservation if they opt to downgrade.
Maya (CS): Also saw an infra alert. @OnboardBot any import failure logs?
OnboardBot: import_job failed for customer:nova-retail at 2024-09-16T09:04:12Z. Error: "KV cache overflow during workspace import". Log snippet: ```ERR KV_CACHE_ALLOC size=0x2a failure at chunk 128```
Maya (CS): OK that's actionable. I'm proposing a three-step save plan: (a) ops hotfix + rollback window, (b) focused enablement blitz, (c) tailored "save offer" with downgrade protection.
Ethan (CSM): Outreach script should reassure them about data integrity and offer a no-cost import retry window. Keep language simple.
Sophie (Enablement): Draft agenda: intro (5m), checklist walk (12m), troubleshooting import (8m), next steps (5m). Record and send clips.
Rohit (RevOps): I'll draft amendment: 3 months at 20% off, downgrade path that preserves export and audit logs, reactivation credit if they churn within 60 days. No permanent data locks.
Maya (CS): Owners & deadlines: Ops patch by EOD tomorrow (owner: infra, loop Rohit), Enablement session scheduled in 48-72h (owner: Sophie), Outreach + amendment draft by EOD today (owner: Ethan).
Ethan (CSM): I'll write the outreach. Subject line options: "Short fix + safe renewal option" or "Quick session to fix imports & renewal offer". Thoughts?
Sophie (Enablement): Prefer the first. Sounds less salesy. Include one-click calendar + checklist snapshot.
Maya (CS): I'll send the personal outreach at 17:00 PT. React with :white_check_mark: when your piece is ready.
OnboardBot: Reminder set: send NovaRetail outreach at 2024-09-16T17:00:00Z.
Ethan (CSM): Draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood.internal/nova/save-offer-draft (internal).
Rohit (RevOps): Reviewed, added legal note on export retention. No blockers.
Sophie (Enablement): Session materials ready. Templates for clips attached to drive.
Maya (CS): Plan if they decline: escalate to exec touch next week. If they accept: run patch -> enablement -> sign amendment.
Ethan (CSM): I'll prepare a 1-pager for execs in case we need escalation.
Maya (CS): Final checklist here: [ ] Ops patch rolled, [ ] Session booked, [ ] Amendment signed, [ ] Follow-up clips sent. Reconvene in this thread if any slip.
Sophie (Enablement): On it.
Rohit (RevOps): On it.
Ethan (CSM): On it.
OnboardBot: Task update: ops_patch -> in_progress.
